newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures closed mixed on Tuesday in thin trade, as a narrowly weaker yen against the dollar offset a lower London market, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.4 yen lower to 2.0 yen higher. The benchmark June 1998 gained to 199.1 yen per kg at one stage, but fell back to 198.6 yen per kg by the close.
"We couldn't find clear market direction today, as there was both bullish and bearish news," said a trader at a major commodity brokerage house.
Some local investors, who were discouraged by a weaker London market overnight, sold nearby months, traders said.
By 0730 GMT, the price of three-month aluminium on the LME stood at $1,665/$1,668 per tonne, against $1,677 at the kerb close on Monday in London.
